Nxeon (VPS/game-hosting business, production Next.js app at /opt/nxeon). Real UI change requested by the owner after seeing a screenshot of the NxLabs `/mods` homepage's game section (currently a multi-row static grid).

## Context
A sibling agent just built `components/mods/GameCatalogueGrid.tsx` (committed as `2ec2214f7c`, NOT yet deployed) to replace the old `PopularGamesStrip` on the marketing `/mods` homepage — real per-game box art, per-game accent color sampled from the art via `lib/game-poster-color.ts`, "Browse mods →" hover reveal, full real family list from `listCatalogFamilies()`. Read this component and its usage in `app/(marketing)/mods/page.tsx` in full first — this is what you're modifying, not `PopularGamesStrip` (leave that alone, it's still used elsewhere at `app/dashboard/nxlabs/page.tsx`).

## What the owner wants (from a real screenshot of the current 5-column, multi-row grid)
1. **A one-row sliding carousel** instead of the multi-row grid — all 17 games in a single horizontal row that scrolls/slides (drag or arrow-button navigation, or both), not wrapping to new rows.
2. **A search bar above the carousel** that narrows down which games appear in it — type a game name, the carousel filters to matching games live (client-side, instant, no page reload — there are only 17 games, no need for server round-trips).

## Implementation notes
- Keep the real per-game accent-color and box-art treatment already built — this is a layout/interaction change, not a visual-identity redo.
- A real horizontal-scroll carousel: consider whether a library is warranted or whether a scroll-snap flex row with drag-to-scroll (or simple prev/next buttons scrolling by one card width) is sufficient for 17 items — this codebase doesn't appear to use a carousel library elsewhere (check `package.json` and `components/` for any existing scroller/carousel pattern first before introducing a new dependency; prefer reusing an existing pattern or plain CSS scroll-snap over adding a new npm package for something this simple).
- The search input should filter the SAME real `listCatalogFamilies()` data already being passed in — no fake/placeholder games, and when the search matches zero games, show a plain honest empty state ("No games match \"x\""), not a blank carousel.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` if you add any transition/animation for the slide behavor.
- This is the MARKETING homepage only (`app/(marketing)/mods/page.tsx`) unless `GameCatalogueGrid` is also used elsewhere — check before assuming.

## CRITICAL process rule (still in force from tonight's incident)
Multiple agents running their own `deploy-staging.sh`/`promote-production.sh` concurrently corrupted the build output earlier tonight and caused a real production outage. **Do NOT run `deploy-staging.sh` or `promote-production.sh` yourself.** Before starting, run `ps aux | grep -E "next build|deploy-staging|promote-production"` — if anything is running, poll every 30s until clear. Make your changes, verify with `npx tsc --noEmit`, commit and push to `main`, then STOP. I (the parent session) am batching several pending commits and will deploy everything together myself.

## Process (mandatory)
- Read `GameCatalogueGrid.tsx`, its usage in `app/(marketing)/mods/page.tsx`, and `lib/mods-catalog.ts`'s `listCatalogFamilies()` in full before editing.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean.
- Commit and push to `main` (check `git log origin/main` before/after for any concurrent pushes — there may be other agents finishing up work in this same tree right now, coordinate/re-pull rather than force-push if origin moved).

Report back: what carousel implementation you chose (library vs. plain CSS/JS) and why, confirmation the search filter works against real data, and confirmation you committed without deploying.
